electricityContract.terms: A copy of the Market Retail Contract is provided and can be seen on our website. Refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/legal/pricing-information/your-rights-and-obligations.

discounts.description: All customers will receive a 6% discount off their electricity supply and usage charges, applied to each monthly or quarterly electricity invoice for a benefit period that runs to 30 June 2027. Discount does not apply to any Greenchoice electricity charges, or miscellaneous fees and charges; and will not apply to any government taxes, fees, levies or charges. For further information, refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/NSW-Standard-electricity-prices-July-2026.
discounts.displayName: Discount off supply and usage charges

electricityContract.variation: If we vary our market offer prices or miscellaneous fees and charges, we will notify you at least five business days before the variation in the tariffs and charges are to apply to you; and deliver the notice by your preferred form of communication where you have communicated this to us, or otherwise by the same method as that used for delivery of your bill.

incentives.description: VPP add-on that allows customers to participate in VPP on current plan. Customers with a compatible battery can enrol. In return, customers receive a $60 quarterly credit ($0.597758 ex gst / day). Key details: Customers remain on current plan and covered under existing VPP Services Agreement. Eligibility: compatible battery needed - see website. Existing ActewAGL customers receive a $100 sign up bonus, and new ActewAGL customers receive a $200 sign up bonus. Call 02 5110 2528 for more details.

VPP add-on available only through Electrify with ActewAGL, for customers purchasing eligible batteries through approved installers. This is in addition to the Battery Power Top-Up. In return, customers receive a $20 quarterly credit ($0.1992528 ex gst /day). Key details: customers remain on current plan, $20 quarterly bill credit ($80/year) and covered under the existing VPP Services Agreement. Eligibility: Compatible battery (full list on website) purchased through Electrify with ActewAGL.

eligibility.description: This offer is only available via phone through the ActewAGL Contact Centre or in person at the ActewAGL Energy Bar.
